properties.view.sqlConfig.spark.databricks.sql.func:
### Instruction

Translate the provided text to %s, and output only the translated text
in the target language in this format: <DBSQLAI>translated text</DBSQLAI>.

If the text is already in the target language, output the provided text.

### Text

%s

view_definition:
WITH ev AS (
  SELECT source_record_id, requested_service,
    max(CASE WHEN evidence_field = 'capability' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS in_capability,
    max(CASE WHEN evidence_field = 'procedure' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS in_procedure,
    max(CASE WHEN evidence_field = 'equipment' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS in_equipment,
    count(DISTINCT evidence_field) AS n_fields,
    array_join(array_sort(collect_set(evidence_field)), ', ') AS evidence_fields
  FROM workspace.carematch.service_evidence
  GROUP BY source_record_id, requested_service
),
base AS (
  SELECT c.source_record_id, c.requested_service,
    coalesce(ev.in_capability, 0) AS in_capability,
    coalesce(ev.in_procedure, 0) AS in_procedure,
    coalesce(ev.in_equipment, 0) AS in_equipment,
    coalesce(ev.n_fields, 0) AS n_fields,
    ev.evidence_fields,
    CASE WHEN coalesce(c.source_url, '') NOT IN ('', 'null', '[]') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS has_source,
    CASE WHEN lower(coalesce(c.evidence_flags, '')) RLIKE 'negation|planned|future' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS f_neg,
    CASE WHEN lower(coalesce(c.evidence_flags, '')) LIKE '%ambiguous%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS f_amb,
    CASE WHEN coalesce(c.identity_flags, '') <> '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS f_id,
    CASE WHEN coalesce(c.location_status, '') LIKE 'Review%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS f_loc
  FROM workspace.carematch.service_candidates c
  LEFT JOIN ev ON ev.source_record_id = c.source_record_id AND ev.requested_service = c.requested_service
),
scored AS (
  SELECT *,
    CAST(greatest(0, least(5,
      in_capability + in_procedure + in_equipment
      + CASE WHEN n_fields >= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END + has_source
      - 2 * f_neg - f_amb - f_id - f_loc)) AS INT) AS evidence_strength
  FROM base
)
SELECT source_record_id, requested_service, evidence_strength, evidence_fields,
  CASE WHEN evidence_strength >= 4 THEN 'Stronger text evidence'
       WHEN evidence_strength >= 2 THEN 'Moderate text evidence'
       ELSE 'Weak text evidence' END AS strength_label,
  concat_ws(', ',
    CASE WHEN in_capability = 1 THEN '+1 listed under capability' END,
    CASE WHEN in_procedure = 1 THEN '+1 listed under procedure' END,
    CASE WHEN in_equipment = 1 THEN '+1 listed under equipment' END,
    CASE WHEN n_fields >= 2 THEN '+1 mentioned in 2 or more fields' END,
    CASE WHEN has_source = 1 THEN '+1 has a source link' END,
    CASE WHEN f_neg = 1 THEN '-2 possible negation or planned service' END,
    CASE WHEN f_amb = 1 THEN '-1 long text may describe another facility' END,
    CASE WHEN f_id = 1 THEN '-1 duplicate or identity warning' END,
    CASE WHEN f_loc = 1 THEN '-1 location needs review' END
  ) AS strength_breakdown
FROM scored

comment: v2 rule-based evidence strength 0-5. Same rules as v1, but only non-negated mentions count, and the -2 negation penalty applies only when every mention is negated. Rates the TEXT, not hospital quality.
name: candidate_strength_v2

view_definition:
WITH ev AS (

    max(CASE WHEN evidence_field = 'capability' AND NOT negated THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS in_capability,
    max(CASE WHEN evidence_field = 'procedure'  AND NOT negated THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS in_procedure,
    max(CASE WHEN evidence_field = 'equipment'  AND NOT negated THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS in_equipment,
    count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN NOT negated THEN evidence_field END) AS n_fields,

    min(CASE WHEN negated THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS all_negated
  FROM workspace.carematch.service_evidence_v2
  GROUP BY source_record_id, requested_service
),
base AS (
  SELECT c.source_record_id, c.requested_service,
    ev.in_capability, ev.in_procedure, ev.in_equipment, ev.n_fields, ev.evidence_fields,
    CASE WHEN coalesce(c.source_url, '') NOT IN ('', 'null', '[]') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS has_source,
    ev.all_negated AS f_neg,
    CASE WHEN lower(coalesce(c.evidence_flags, '')) LIKE '%ambiguous%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS f_amb,
    CASE WHEN coalesce(c.identity_flags, '') <> '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS f_id,
    CASE WHEN coalesce(c.location_status, '') LIKE 'Review%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS f_loc
  FROM workspace.carematch.service_candidates_v2 c
  JOIN ev ON ev.source_record_id = c.source_record_id AND ev.requested_service = c.requested_service
),
scored AS (
  SELECT *,
    CAST(greatest(0, least(5,
      in_capability + in_procedure + in_equipment
      + CASE WHEN n_fields >= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END + has_source
      - 2 * f_neg - f_amb - f_id - f_loc)) AS INT) AS evidence_strength
  FROM base
)
SELECT source_record_id, requested_service, evidence_strength, evidence_fields,
  CASE WHEN evidence_strength >= 4 THEN 'Stronger text evidence'
       WHEN evidence_strength >= 2 THEN 'Moderate text evidence'
       ELSE 'Weak text evidence' END AS strength_label,
  concat_ws(', ',
    CASE WHEN in_capability = 1 THEN '+1 listed under capability' END,
    CASE WHEN in_procedure = 1 THEN '+1 listed under procedure' END,
    CASE WHEN in_equipment = 1 THEN '+1 listed under equipment' END,
    CASE WHEN n_fields >= 2 THEN '+1 mentioned in 2 or more fields' END,
    CASE WHEN has_source = 1 THEN '+1 has a source link' END,
    CASE WHEN f_neg = 1 THEN '-2 every mention is negated or planned' END,
    CASE WHEN f_amb = 1 THEN '-1 long text may describe another facility' END,
    CASE WHEN f_id = 1 THEN '-1 duplicate or identity warning' END,
    CASE WHEN f_loc = 1 THEN '-1 location needs review' END
  ) AS strength_breakdown

### Instruction

Translate the provided text to %s, and output only the translated text
in the target language in this format: <DBSQLAI>translated text</DBSQLAI>.

If the text is already in the target language, output the provided text.

### Text

%s

view_definition:
WITH src AS (
  SELECT unique_id,
    nullif(trim(concat_ws(', ', filter(array(address_line1, address_line2, address_line3), x -> x IS NOT NULL AND trim(x) NOT IN ('', 'null')))), '') AS street_address
  FROM databricks_virtue_foundation_dataset_dais_2026.virtue_foundation_dataset.facilities
),
src_agg AS (
  SELECT unique_id, first(street_address, true) AS street_address, count(DISTINCT street_address) AS n_addresses
  FROM src GROUP BY unique_id
)
SELECT
  f.facility_id, f.source_record_id, f.facility_name, f.state, f.city, f.postcode,
  s.street_address,
  concat_ws(', ', s.street_address, f.city, f.state, f.postcode) AS full_address,
  CASE WHEN s.n_addresses > 1 THEN 'Source lists different addresses for this facility ID' END AS address_flag,
  nullif(translate(coalesce(nullif(f.official_phone, 'null'), f.phone_numbers), '[]"', ''), '') AS phone,
  nullif(translate(coalesce(nullif(f.official_website, 'null'), f.websites), '[]"', ''), '') AS website
FROM workspace.carematch.facility_records f
LEFT JOIN src_agg s ON f.raw_unique_id = s.unique_id

properties.view.sqlConfig.spark.databricks.sql.func:
### Instruction

Translate the provided text to %s, and output only the translated text
in the target language in this format: <DBSQLAI>translated text</DBSQLAI>.

If the text is already in the target language, output the provided text.

### Text

%s

view_definition:
WITH valid_source AS (
  SELECT *,
    row_number() OVER (
      PARTITION BY unique_id
      ORDER BY
        CASE WHEN source_urls IS NOT NULL AND trim(source_urls) NOT IN ('','[]','null','NULL') THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,
        CASE WHEN latitude IS NOT NULL AND longitude IS NOT NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,
        sha2(concat_ws('||', coalesce(name,''),coalesce(address_city,''),coalesce(description,'')),256)
    ) AS source_row_number,
    count(*) OVER (PARTITION BY unique_id) AS source_id_row_count,
    lower(regexp_replace(trim(coalesce(name,'')), '[^a-z0-9]+', '')) AS norm_name,
    lower(trim(coalesce(address_city,''))) AS norm_city,
    lower(trim(coalesce(address_stateOrRegion,''))) AS norm_state
  FROM databricks_virtue_foundation_dataset_dais_2026.virtue_foundation_dataset.facilities
  WHERE unique_id RLIKE '^[0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}$'
), flagged AS (
  SELECT *,
    count(*) OVER (PARTITION BY norm_name,norm_city,norm_state) AS name_location_row_count,
    count(*) OVER (PARTITION BY latitude,longitude) AS coordinate_row_count
  FROM valid_source
)
SELECT
  unique_id AS facility_id,
  concat(unique_id,'::',lpad(cast(source_row_number AS STRING),3,'0')) AS source_record_id,
  unique_id AS raw_unique_id,
  name AS facility_name,
  organization_type,
  address_stateOrRegion AS state,
  address_city AS city,
  cast(address_zipOrPostcode AS STRING) AS postcode,
  latitude,
  longitude,
  description,
  specialties,
  capability,
  procedure AS procedure,
  equipment,
  phone_numbers,
  officialPhone AS official_phone,
  websites,
  officialWebsite AS official_website,
  source_types,
  source_ids,
  source_content_id,
  content_table_id,
  source_urls AS source_urls_raw,
  coalesce(
    element_at(from_json(source_urls,'array<string>'),1),
    CASE WHEN officialWebsite IS NOT NULL AND trim(officialWebsite)<>'' THEN officialWebsite END,
    element_at(from_json(websites,'array<string>'),1)
  ) AS source_url,
  recency_of_page_update AS source_update_text,
  CASE
    WHEN latitude IS NULL OR longitude IS NULL THEN 'Unresolved — coordinates missing'
    WHEN latitude BETWEEN 6 AND 38 AND longitude BETWEEN 68 AND 98 THEN 'Usable — broad India bounding-box plausible'
    ELSE 'Review — outside broad India bounding box'
  END AS location_status,
  concat_ws('; ', filter(array(
    IF(source_id_row_count>1,'Duplicate source facility ID',NULL),
    IF(name_location_row_count>1,'Possible duplicate name and location',NULL),
    IF(latitude IS NOT NULL AND longitude IS NOT NULL AND coordinate_row_count>1,'Repeated coordinates',NULL),
    IF(latitude IS NOT NULL AND longitude IS NOT NULL AND NOT(latitude BETWEEN 6 AND 38 AND longitude BETWEEN 68 AND 98),'Coordinate outside broad India bounding box',NULL),
    IF(source_urls IS NULL OR trim(source_urls) IN ('','[]','null','NULL'),'Source URL missing',NULL)
  ), x -> x IS NOT NULL)) AS identity_flags,
  source_id_row_count,
  name_location_row_count,
  CASE WHEN latitude IS NOT NULL AND longitude IS NOT NULL THEN coordinate_row_count ELSE NULL END AS coordinate_row_count
FROM flagged

properties.view.sqlConfig.spark.databricks.sql.func:
### Instruction

Translate the provided text to %s, and output only the translated text
in the target language in this format: <DBSQLAI>translated text</DBSQLAI>.

If the text is already in the target language, output the provided text.

### Text

%s

view_definition:
WITH p AS (
  SELECT
    lpad(cast(pincode AS STRING),6,'0') AS postcode,
    trim(statename) AS state,
    trim(district) AS district,
    trim(officename) AS office_name,
    try_cast(latitude AS DOUBLE) AS latitude,
    try_cast(longitude AS DOUBLE) AS longitude
  FROM databricks_virtue_foundation_dataset_dais_2026.virtue_foundation_dataset.india_post_pincode_directory
)
SELECT
  postcode,
  sort_array(collect_set(state)) AS states,
  sort_array(collect_set(district)) AS districts,
  sort_array(collect_set(office_name)) AS office_names,
  count(*) AS source_row_count,
  count(DISTINCT state) AS state_count,
  count(DISTINCT district) AS district_count,
  avg(CASE WHEN latitude BETWEEN 6 AND 38 AND longitude BETWEEN 68 AND 98 THEN latitude END) AS approximate_latitude,
  avg(CASE WHEN latitude BETWEEN 6 AND 38 AND longitude BETWEEN 68 AND 98 THEN longitude END) AS approximate_longitude,
  CASE
    WHEN count(DISTINCT state)>1 OR count(DISTINCT district)>1 THEN 'Ambiguous — multiple state/district labels'
    WHEN count_if(latitude BETWEEN 6 AND 38 AND longitude BETWEEN 68 AND 98)=0 THEN 'Unresolved — no plausible coordinates'
    ELSE 'Approximate PIN centroid — not a facility location'
  END AS location_status
FROM p
GROUP BY postcode
